newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-KESKO JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-KESKO JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 230 million markka median
forecast for Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy's
January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (FIM)
Median 230 1.9
Mean 239 1.8
Lowest 200 1.7
Highest 350 2.1
(Profit forecasts by nine analysts, EPS by five analysts).
Kesko's four-month results are due on June 11.
In January-April 1996, Kesko posted a profit before
extraordinaries and tax of 198 million markka.
The median of six analysts' forecasts for Kesko's full-year
1997 profit before extras and tax was 805 million markka (mean
801 million) in a 760-833 million markka range.
In 1996, Kesko's profit was 740 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Erik Selin, FIM
Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities
and Postipankki.
